This post demonstrates how Python code runs in Quarto.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.plot(x, y, color='blue', label='Sin(x)')
plt.title("Simple Sine Wave")
plt.xlabel("X")
plt.ylabel("Y")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```
